compiled_state.title: GREEN: add parent_status_uuid to STATUS event writes in ticket-transition.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

Add parent_status_uuid field to STATUS events written by ticket-transition.sh. Makes T10 tests pass.

Implementation:
1. Before writing a new STATUS event, list the ticket's existing STATUS events in chronological order (by event filename timestamp or sorted by filename)
2. If no prior STATUS events exist: parent_status_uuid = null (JSON null)
3. If prior STATUS events exist: parent_status_uuid = basename of most recent STATUS event file, without .json extension (e.g. 'a3f290bc-1234-5678-90ab-cdef01234567')
4. Embed parent_status_uuid in the new STATUS event JSON payload

The field must always be present in the written JSON. Never omit it.

depends_on: T10 (05c1-6855)
